label: Domestic flight

source.name: UK DEFRA / BEIS Greenhouse Gas Conversion Factors

methodology: DEFRA 2025 domestic flight factor, average passenger, including radiative forcing. Applied to an assumed average domestic round trip distance (see calculations/flights.ts) since users report trips, not distances.

label: Short-haul international flight (under ~3,700 km)

source.name: UK DEFRA / BEIS Greenhouse Gas Conversion Factors

methodology: DEFRA 2025 short-haul economy-class factor, including radiative forcing.

label: Long-haul international flight (over ~3,700 km)

source.name: UK DEFRA / BEIS Greenhouse Gas Conversion Factors

methodology: DEFRA 2025 long-haul economy-class factor, including radiative forcing. Used as the default factor for a user-reported 'international trip' since most international travel involves at least one long-haul segment.
